subject: Handoff: WellCare AI deployment — MAP, SOW & owner assignment
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Handoff: WellCare AI deployment - MAP & runbook

Hannah / Monica,

Quick handoff: WellCare AI (Deal DW-27391) signed yesterday — $360k ARR, committed start date May 9th. Key facts up front:
- Deployment: Private VPC (AWS account will be customer-managed), initial footprint: 2 dedicated pods (NVIDIA A100x2 equiv), burst to 4 for go-live.
- SOW signed — attached PDF. Billing cadence: net-30 after milestone acceptance.
- Security: customer requires SOC 2 attestation + audit log export cadence; procurement already requested evidence (see procurement@wellcare.ai).

Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (WellCareAI_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a kickoff agenda draft. As sales I can join first 30m of the kickoff.

Immediate asks for Sales->CS transfer: 
1) Nominate primary CS owner and technical lead.
2) Confirm technical intake steps for VPC networking and KMS configuration (we need this before environment provisioning).
3) Propose two 60m kickoff slots between 5/3–5/6 so we can hit the 5/9 start date.

Risks: customer has a hard deadline for a pilot the first week of May and will expect an environment with SSO + scoped sample dataset. There may be delays if VPC peering or encryption keys are not ready.

Monica — can you take primary for this? If you'd prefer to shadow-handoff to someone else, please flag.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment: SOW_WellCareAI_20270420.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: WellCareAI_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: WellCare AI deployment - MAP & runbook

Karthik — thanks for the clear summary and the docs.

On Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 9:12 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hannah / Monica,
> 
> Quick handoff: WellCare AI (Deal DW-27391) signed yesterday — $360k ARR, committed start date May 9th.
> ...

Monica will be primary CS owner for this engagement. I am assigning Rohan Mehta as the technical onboarding lead (rohan_mehta@redwood.com) to handle environment provisioning and the VPC/KMS intake. Action items and owners below: 

- CS owner (customer relationship & acceptance): Monica Patel — owner for runbook, training, and success metrics.
- Technical lead (environment build + infra test): Rohan Mehta — will own VPC peering, test account, and SSO enablement checklist.
- Sales liaison (escalations / scope clarifications): Karthik Iyer.

Monica — please confirm you accept, and post a 1-week plan in the shared Runbook folder (link below). If everything looks good I will schedule the kickoff for 5/4 11:00am PT (proposed) or 5/5 09:00am PT as backup.

I noted the SOC 2 ask — Sarah in Security can pull the attestation artifacts; Monica/Tee off with Security for evidence packaging.

Link to working runbook: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-wellcare-handovers

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

From: Bethany King <bethany@wellcare.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T10:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: WellCare AI deployment - MAP & runbook

Hi Hannah / Monica / Karthik,

Thanks — excited to get started. A couple quick questions from the customer side before the kickoff: 
1) Training: who will run the admin + end-user training sessions and how long do you expect those to take?
2) SSO: we requested SAML SSO in the SOW; do you support Okta out of the box or do we need custom work?
3) Pilot data: can we run a 2-week pilot with a subset of our production data before the May 9th go-live? If so, what environment isolation will that require?

Also looping in procurement (procurement@wellcare.ai) to confirm DocuSign and invoicing details.

If possible we would prefer kickoff on 5/3 afternoon ET — does that still work?

Best,
Bethany King
Director of Product, WellCare AI
bethany@wellcare.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-23T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: WellCare AI deployment - MAP & runbook

Thanks Bethany — all good questions. Confirming CS plan and next steps below.

On Wed, Apr 21, 2027 at 10:33 AM Bethany King <bethany@wellcare.ai> wrote:
> Hi Hannah / Monica / Karthik,
> 
> Thanks — excited to get started. A couple quick questions from the customer side before the kickoff: ...

Monica here — I accept primary ownership. Brief responses: 
- Training: CS will run Admin + End-User sessions. Admin session (90m) + End-User (60m). We can do a recorded follow-up.
- SSO: Okta is supported via SAML; Rohan will own the assertion setup and test plan. If custom claims are required we'll scope as a small engineering ticket during onboarding.
- Pilot: Yes — we can provision an isolated staging workspace for a 2-week pilot. Rohan will outline the environment requirements; we typically mirror the VPC/EKS networking but with sampled data.

Proposed kickoff: 5/4 11:00am PT (as Hannah suggested) — Monica/Karthik/Hannah/Rohan + customer stakeholders. Monica will publish a 7-day onboarding plan in the Runbook folder by EOD 4/24 and will include the training schedule and acceptance criteria.

Internal notes / quick risks: procurement already asked for invoicing to be billed to WellCare AI, not a holding company — Karthik please confirm invoice details with procurement contact. Also plan to pull SOC2 evidence; I will coordinate with Security for the evidence packet.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Attachment: kickoff-agenda-draft.pdf (pdf)
Runbook draft: https://docs.redwood.com/sops/launch-runbook-templates#wellcare
